note_en: Commissioning year 2016: Inox Wind announced on 2 March 2016 a turnkey order from PTC Energy for a 20 MW project at Nipaniya, Mandsaur district, Madhya Pradesh, due by March 2016; in April 2017 PTC Energy said it already had 50 MW operating in Madhya Pradesh and that its new total of 288.8 MW was nearly six times its capacity at the start of fiscal 2016–17 (April 2016), i.e. about 50 MW then. Besides the 30 MW Jaora farm commissioned on 8 March 2016, that leaves Nipaniya’s 20 MW operating by the end of March 2016
why: Not written in round 23: the year 2016 is worked out indirectly, not stated in a source. The year is derived, not stated in one sentence: (1) the 10 × 2 MW Inox order was announced on 2 Mar 2016, so it was not built before March 2016; (2) by April 2017 PTC Energy had 50 MW operating in MP, which can only be Jaora (30 MW, 8 Mar 2016) + Nipaniya (20 MW); (3) 288.8 MW being 'nearly 6 times' the capacity at the start of FY2016-17 means about 50 MW on 1 Apr 2016 (with only Jaora it would be ~9.6 times). So Nipaniya was commissioned in March 2016. If the caller treats this arithmetic as too indirect, downgrade to lead (year 2016 or early 2017). Owner: PTC Energy Ltd (100% PTC India subsidiary at the time).
